meta.fields: n: Street View locations in the source; one: solo hedge {p: [lat, lng], e: expected round score, m: miss distance km [median, 90th percentile, max]}; two: team hedge {p: [[lat, lng], [lat, lng]], e, s: share of locations the first pin is closer to, m}; cells: covered grid cells, delta-encoded
meta.method: Pins maximise the expected round score 5000 * exp(-d / scoreScaleKm) over the country's Street View locations (team: the better of the two guesses counts).
